work: Li, Zhang, and Hassan; AIDev: Studying AI Coding Agents on GitHub
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Introduces AIDev and describes multi-agent adoption and PR outcomes

work: Pinna et al.; Comparing AI Coding Agents: A Task-Stratified Analysis of Pull Request Acceptance
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Task type can explain acceptance differences better than a global agent ranking
residual_novelty: Transition study must adjust for task and agent pair

work: Ehsani et al.; Where Do AI Coding Agents Fail?
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Characterizes merged and unmerged PRs and correlates of rejection
residual_novelty: Does not study the next outcome-known episode

work: Peralta et al.; Why Are Agentic Pull Requests Merged or Rejected?
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Only a subset of rejected PRs are clearly attributable to agent failure
residual_novelty: Supports neutral closed-unmerged terminology; no downstream transition

work: Xu et al.; AI Agent Pull Requests on GitHub: Frequency, Structure, and Merge Conflict Rates
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Studies concurrent same- and cross-agent PR conflict
residual_novelty: Present study uses non-overlapping sequential episodes

work: Shastry et al.; Beyond Isolated Tasks: A Framework for Evaluating Coding Agents on Sequential Software Evolution
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Studies artifact carryover across benchmark tasks
residual_novelty: No observed brand/contributor reconfiguration in OSS

work: Chung and Hassan; Collaborator or Assistant?
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Separates agent initiation from human governance within PR lifecycles
residual_novelty: Does not identify cross-PR tool-selection decisions

work: Cynthia, Das, and Roy; Are We All Using Agents the Same Way?
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Developer roles differ in delegation, review, and CI verification
residual_novelty: Contributor continuity must be a first-class transition dimension

work: Yoshioka et al.; Let's Make Every Pull Request Meaningful
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Submitter attributes strongly shape merge outcomes
residual_novelty: Separating contributor turnover from brand change is residual novelty

work: Nachuma and Zibran; When AI Teammates Meet Code Review
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Review engagement and PR change dynamics relate to integration
residual_novelty: Review is a mechanism/confounder; no outcome-conditioned next-agent transition

work: Yu et al.; Habituation at the Gate
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Reviewer approval and scrutiny evolve with exposure and time
residual_novelty: Calendar/exposure adjustment needed; no brand-contributor transition taxonomy

work: Longoni, Cian, and Kyung; Algorithmic Transference
evidence_relevant_to_overlap: Experiments show failure perceptions can generalize across AI systems
residual_novelty: Trace data do not measure perception or trust; theory only
